title.narrative: Enhancing the 21st Century Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) knowledge and support to 12 years Basic Education students: Pilot project in Kamonyi, Nyagatare, Rubavu and Gicumbi

description.narrative:
Project’s main overall objective To provide 12YBE adolescents and young people in Rwanda with an opportunity to learn more about themselves, their interests, strengths, family and personal values and the factors that influence their sexuality.
Project’s specific objectives and planned activities to achieve expected results. 1. To reach out to 12YBE adolescents and young people and equip them with skills that help them become competent enough in the context of sex and youth reproductive health without compromising culture and religion in Rwanda. This will be done through awareness raising in terms of trainings, massive campaigns and using mass media and organizing youth competitions in writing poems and music dance and drama and sports activities. The project will also distribute pads to 300 most vulnerable girls from poor families. 2. To equip teachers with skills and approaches that will help them tackle Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) in their class. This will help student develop positive attitudes towards Boy-Girl relations and the youth will be able to cope with sex related challenges and dilemma. The Knowledge will also result in prevention of early pregnancies that many girls in Eastern and southern province have been victims of. This will be done through training teachers on CSE in schools where they have not been trained, providing monitoring tools to trained teachers to capture progress and documenting gaps and lesson learnt for future improvement. Provide IEC’s and printed curriculums to teachers who may not have received them. 3. To ensure adolescent students and young people can freely talk about issues that affect their Sexual Reproductive Health and adopt ways and manners that help make informed decisions concerning Boy-Girl relations and sexuality. Group discussions, hands-on activities and competitions will involve them in deepening the problem and by doing so they will develop the required competences in the field of Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE). Trainings in form of group discussions will be given to more than 13,500 individuals. Trainees will be both teachers (60) and 12YBE students from 30 secondary schools. RWACHI is expecting to use different activities to achieve the project’s goal.
